verdict.rationale: The only evidence of region choice is a community report that Fastmail launched an EU (Amsterdam) region. The same report says Fastmail can't guarantee data stays only in the EU, so strict residency is not assured. Another user notes data otherwise sits under Australian and American jurisdictions. missing for 10: first-party documentation of region selection, a guaranteed residency commitment, a list of available regions, and how to choose or migrate between them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Criticism of Fastmail's new EU (Amsterdam) region: they state they can't guarantee data remains only in the EU
